systemStatement: ReelOS is one end-to-end local neural system. Search, taste, preparation, playback, storage, machine health, interface adaptation, scene understanding, family analysis, and recovery share one event and feature spine. Deterministic policy remains authoritative.

lifecycleDefinitions.fallback: Registered with deterministic behavior; no model result is authoritative.
lifecycleDefinitions.shadow: Runs only to collect local evaluation evidence; cannot change the user-visible decision.
lifecycleDefinitions.assisted: May propose a result through the coordinator, subject to deterministic policy and fallback.
lifecycleDefinitions.autonomous: May execute only the narrow signed capability already allowed by deterministic policy.
lifecycleDefinitions.offline: Installed metadata exists, but no executable path is available.

capabilities.purpose: Learn profile-private taste and rank titles without exposing viewing history.
capabilities.fallback: Deterministic taste projection and curated ranking.
capabilities.privacy: profile-private; no raw history leaves the home
capabilities.resourceBudget: interactive; 250 ms proposal deadline; yields to playback

capabilities.purpose: Interpret natural-language title, person, feeling, exclusion, and remembered-scene queries.
Derive edition-bound scene, actor, character, and object observations for local features.
capabilities.fallback: No inferred scene claims; use supplied metadata and subtitles only.
capabilities.privacy: home-private; media and analysis never leave the home
capabilities.resourceBudget: background only; interruptible; yields to playback and pressure

capabilities.purpose: Propose edition-bound family severity annotations without weakening parent policy.
capabilities.fallback: Deterministic maturity baseline and parent-authored boundaries.
capabilities.privacy: home-private; family settings and analysis remain local
capabilities.resourceBudget: background only; never blocks playback or policy evaluation

capabilities.purpose: Evaluate local dialogue separation or rewriting without changing originals.
capabilities.fallback: Original audio, available tracks, subtitles, and deterministic level controls.
capabilities.privacy: home-private; audio and derived features remain local
capabilities.resourceBudget: offline or background; interruptible; playback has priority

capabilities.purpose: Predict useful device-compatible renditions before demand.
capabilities.fallback: Direct play, existing rendition, remux, then bounded explicit preparation.
capabilities.resourceBudget: background; cancellable; yields immediately to playback and pressure

capabilities.purpose: Recommend retention and disposable rendition choices within household storage policy.
capabilities.fallback: Deterministic reservation floors, pinned-media protection, and managed-only eviction.
capabilities.privacy: home-private; originals and credentials are never model-controlled

capabilities.purpose: Learn pressure patterns while deterministic limits protect the machine.
capabilities.fallback: Deterministic resource governor floors and cancellation.
capabilities.resourceBudget: continuous bounded sampling; deterministic governor is final

capabilities.purpose: Adapt presentation and decorative work without compromising navigation or accessibility.
outputs: bounded motion, density, and atmosphere proposal
capabilities.fallback: Saved profile preferences with device accessibility overrides.
capabilities.resourceBudget: interactive; decorative work suspends under pressure

capabilities.purpose: Evaluate authorized taste matching among members of the same Home without exporting learning beyond it.
capabilities.fallback: Entirely local taste learning with no Home sharing.
capabilities.privacy: learning remains within the Home; no cross-Home export; blocked until membership, re-identification, and payload-boundary tests pass
capabilities.resourceBudget: background and Home-network-budgeted; disabled by default

capabilities.purpose: Rank bounded recovery or rollout recommendations from local evidence.
capabilities.fallback: Deterministic health gates, signed updates, rollback, and explicit retry.
capabilities.resourceBudget: background; cannot authorize installation or deletion
